steps.title: Basic Trip Details
steps.description: Set the foundation — destination, dates, and who's traveling

fields.label: Use Template
fields.hint: Start from a saved template or begin from scratch

custom.message: End date must be on or after start date

steps.onComplete: Compute tripDuration = endDate - startDate in days. Generate empty day structures.

steps.title: Hotels
steps.description: Assign hotels for each day — pick a hotel, then choose room type and meal plan

fields.label: Same hotel for multiple days?
fields.hint: Link consecutive days to same hotel — only fill once

steps.uiPattern: Per-day card stack: each day is a card with hotel selector at top, then inline room type checkboxes, meal plan checkboxes, and room count. No modal. No separate form.

hotelCardLayout.header: Day X — [Date] | Hotel selector (HotelAutocomplete with destination filter)
hotelCardLayout.body: Room Type checkboxes (from hotel.roomTypes) | Meal Plan checkboxes (from hotel.mealPlans)
hotelCardLayout.footer: Room count number input | 'Apply to next N days' toggle
hotelCardLayout.collapsedState: Hotel name + room type + meal plan summary chip

steps.spanningLogic: If user selects 'same hotel for 3 days', collapse those 3 day cards into one hotel entry and show day range in the card header.

custom.rule: hotelId must be valid hotel id from catalogue
custom.message: Please select a hotel from the database

steps.onComplete: Compute per-day hotel costs: roomType.basePrice * roomCount * travelers + mealPlan.pricePerNight * roomCount * travelers. Store in day costs.

steps.title: Transport
steps.description: Assign vehicles for each day — pick a vehicle, then choose type and driver options

fields.label: Vehicle
fields.hint: Optional — leave blank if no vehicle needed that day

steps.uiPattern: Per-day card stack: each day is a card with vehicle selector at top, then inline vehicle type checkboxes and driver toggle. 'No vehicle needed' skip link per day.

vehicleCardLayout.header: Day X — [Date] | Vehicle selector (VehicleAutocomplete) | 'Skip this day' link
vehicleCardLayout.body: Vehicle type checkbox group | Driver included toggle | Pickup/Drop text inputs
vehicleCardLayout.collapsedState: Vehicle name + driver indicator + pickup→drop summary

steps.onComplete: Compute per-day vehicle costs: selectedVehicle.ratePerDay * days. Store in day costs.

steps.title: Final Details
steps.description: Review your selections, add inclusions and exclusions, and set up package options
steps.uiPattern: Summary section at top (read-only review of all 4 steps) + editable inclusions/exclusions/notes/package options below.

quoteCards.autoCalcBreakdown: hotelCost, vehicleCost from day data * travelers
quoteCards.quickTemplates: Basic, Standard, Premium, Luxury, Advance with predefined features
quoteCards.liveCalc: Subtotal + margin % + GST % = Grand Total, with 'Apply to price field' button

summarySection.hotelSummary: readOnly: Hotel names per day with room type + meal plan chips
summarySection.vehicleSummary: readOnly: Vehicle names per day with driver indicator

steps.onComplete: Call createItinerary API with full daysJson, redirect to /itineraries/[id]/page.tsx
